d: Mokama ke purv vidhayak anant sinh par unke behad karibi aur rishtedar aarjedi emaelsi (RJD MLC) kartik kumar ka bara bayan samne aaya hai. kartik kumar ne saph kaha ki aarjedi chhorkar jediyu (JDU) men jana anant sinh ka galat phaisla tha aur aaj uska natija sabke samne hai. anant sinh khud svikar kar chuke hain ki unse aarjedi ke sath jane men bhul huee thi.
